questions.question: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
Why are copper wires used in electricity cables?

answers.a: Copper is an insulator and protects against shocks
answers.b: Copper conducts electricity very well and is easy to shape
answers.c: Copper does not rust and that is the only requirement
answers.d: Copper is lighter than all other metals

questions.question: What is an alloy?

answers.a: A solution of a metal in water
answers.b: A pure metal with a high melting point
answers.c: A mixture of a metal with one or more other substances (usually other metals as well)
answers.d: A compound of a metal with oxygen

questions.question: What is bronze made of?
What is brass made of?
What is steel made of?

answers.b: Iron with a small amount of carbon

questions.question: Why do people sometimes make an alloy instead of using a pure metal?

answers.a: The alloy is always cheaper than a pure metal
answers.b: The alloy has better properties, for example it is harder or rusts less quickly
answers.c: A pure metal does not exist
answers.d: The alloy conducts better than any pure metal

questions.question: What is needed for iron to rust?
What is galvanising?

answers.a: Covering an iron object with a layer of zinc

questions.question: Why does aluminium not rust through?

answers.b: Aluminium does not react with oxygen
answers.c: A thin, dense layer of aluminium oxide forms on the surface and protects the metal
answers.d: Aluminium is a noble metal that never reacts

questions.question: What is an ore?

answers.b: A pure metal in the ground
answers.c: A gas that comes out of the earth
answers.d: A rock from which you can extract a metal

questions.question: What is the iron that comes out of the blast furnace called?
Why is recycling metals important?

answers.a: Pure metal only exists as recycled metal
answers.b: Metal becomes heavier when it is recycled
